title: Persist XP values and store badges in backend

requirements.text: Add stable storage for XP values in backend/main.mo, tracking XP per user with persistence across upgrades
acceptanceCriteria: XP values are stored in stable storage in backend/main.mo
XP can be queried and updated via backend methods

requirements.text: Add stable storage for badges in backend/main.mo, tracking unlocked badges per user with persistence across upgrades
acceptanceCriteria: Badge data is stored in stable storage in backend/main.mo
Badges can be queried and updated via backend methods
Badge unlock state is preserved for each user

constraints: Use stable storage for persistence across upgrades
